relations.rationale: Cleo's relative age has no bearing on how she ranked the walk.
Ages of Cleo and Uma relative to Bo have no bearing on Jude spotting a woodpecker.

Uma being on Jude's team combined with Bo not being on Jude's team implies Bo and Uma are on different teams, but this doesn't directly support or contradict claim 25 itself which is independently stated; the two claims are consistent but 20 doesn't establish 25's truth.
The group pausing at the bend doesn't confirm or deny a kingfisher sighting there the previous week.
Pausing near the river bend is a location detail unrelated to Jude spotting a woodpecker in an oak tree.
A prior kingfisher sighting at the bend has no bearing on Jude spotting a woodpecker in an oak tree.
Jude's sighting being pointed out plausibly leads to Noor recording it, suggesting a supportive link.
Jude's woodpecker sighting is one instance that could contribute to the overall count of species reaching over twenty.
Noor recording sightings suggests careful tracking, supporting the idea that many species were counted.
Cleo ranking the walk highly is consistent with pleasant weather but doesn't establish it caused the weather; it's more likely a result of it, so it lends some support to the weather being pleasant.
Pleasant weather could encourage more birdwatching activity, supporting a higher species count.
